obs: “The suppression of abuses resulting from violations of 6 (7) would be rendered practically impossible if the Commission were required to suppress all simultaneously or none. Section 12 (1) imposes on the Commission the duty to enforce the provisions of the Act. That duty under 6 (7) would hardly be performed if the Commission were to decline to enforce it against one because it could not at the same time enforce it against all.”
"Furthermore, we do not think that the federal law imposes a standard with which it is impossible to comply."
